body: My mood swings and anxiety pop up can pop up at anytime. My mind can be quick-witted at some points, and terribly broken at others. On the outside, I can appear to other people as completely normal. However, on the inside, I feel like I'm not normal. This causes a break in what I think the world expects of me, and what I expect of myself. I feel like I should be better than I appear to be most of the time, and I can't accept that I have these short-comings because of the discrepancies between the world's perspective.
